mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE category WHEN 'PROJECT' THEN 3.0 WHEN 'STUDY' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'RUN' THEN 1.5 WHEN 'LIFE' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM done_item i JOIN daily_log l ON l.id = i.daily_log_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.log_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{weekEnd}) AS quality_score, (SELECT NVL(AVG(energy), 5.0) FROM daily_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{weekStart} + 2) AS first_half_avg, (SELECT NVL(AVG(energy), 5.0) FROM daily_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} + 3 AND #{weekEnd}) AS second_half_avg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date BETWEEN #{weekStart} AND #{weekEnd}) AS log_count FROM DUAL

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE category WHEN 'LIFE' THEN 5 WHEN 'STUDY' THEN 10 WHEN 'RUN' THEN 15 WHEN 'PROJECT' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM done_item i JOIN daily_log l ON l.id = i.daily_log_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId}

/* 오늘 또는 어제부터 시작하여 끊기지 않은 연속 일수 계산 */ WITH activity_dates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT l.log_date FROM done_item i JOIN daily_log l ON l.id = i.daily_log_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ), streak_groups AS ( SELECT log_date, log_date - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY log_date) AS streak_group, MAX(log_date) OVER () AS latest_date FROM activity_dates ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM streak_groups WHERE latest_date >= #{today} - 1 AND streak_group = ( SELECT streak_group FROM streak_groups WHERE log_date = (SELECT MAX(log_date) FROM streak_groups) )

/* LEAD 함수를 사용하여 어제와 오늘 고민 강도 차이의 평균 산출 */ SELECT NVL(AVG(diff), 0.0) FROM ( SELECT LEAD(worry_intensity) OVER (ORDER BY log_date DESC) - worry_intensity as diff, log_date, LEAD(log_date) OVER (ORDER BY log_date DESC) as prev_date FROM daily_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND log_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) WHERE log_date = prev_date + 1
